featured_reviews.name: Girlbehindthebrands
featured_reviews.review_text:
When Juices Steal the Show & Food Blows Your Mind! 🍹🍕🔥
Hidden in the heart of Borivali, Bunty’s Snacks & Juice Center is an absolute delight for anyone who loves experimenting with new flavours! 😍

Let’s start with the juices — honestly, they stole the show! From the tangy twist of Captain Juice to the vibrant, colourful Rangoli Juice, each one is refreshing and full of unique blends. The Salaar Juice packs a real punch — bold, chilled, and energizing — while Darna Mana Hai Juice is a fun, must-try surprise for brave hearts! 🥤

Moving to food, every bite is pure comfort. The Humpty Dumpty Toast is a crunchy, cheesy treat that instantly wins you over. The Festival Pizza truly lives up to its name — loaded, flavourful, and festive in every bite! 🍕 The Nachni Bhel is a healthy yet tasty twist, and the Gol Gappa Kabab is a total showstopper — chatpata, crunchy, and bursting with flavour!

And just when you think it can’t get better, the Strawberry Cream and Film City Dessert arrive to seal the deal — creamy, dreamy, and picture-perfect endings! 🍓🍨

If you’re in Borivali and haven’t been here yet, you’re missing out on a local gem. Great taste, quick service, and a vibe that makes you want to come back again and again

featured_reviews.name: DNB Travel & Food Reviews
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Visited Bunty Juice Center – One of the Most Famous Juice & Snack Spots in Borivali

Visited Bunty Juice Center in Borivali West and had a really enjoyable experience. This place is very popular for its huge variety of juices, shakes, desserts, sandwiches, and snacks with unique presentation style.

🍹 Food & Drinks:
The menu is extremely creative with interesting names and unique serving style. Must-try items include Gabbar Mango Shake, Kiwi Strawberry Juice, Chocolate Thali, Strawberry Cream, Festival Pizza, Chowpatty Sandwich, and Jungli Sandwich. Taste was fresh, flavorful, and presentation was eye-catching.

🍨 Desserts & Presentation:
Desserts and shakes are one of the biggest highlights here. The presentation is very different and trendy, which makes it fun especially for youngsters and families.

💰 Price:
Approx ₹250–₹500 per person depending on your order. Some items feel slightly premium priced, but quantity and creativity balance it well.

🏠 Ambience:
The place has colorful interiors, vibrant atmosphere, and cozy seating. It is usually crowded in evenings and weekends because of its popularity.

👨‍🍳 Staff & Service:
Staff is generally helpful and service is quick even during rush hours. They also guide properly if you are confused by the large menu.

🚗 Parking:
Parking can be difficult during peak time because the area gets crowded. Better to visit slightly early in evenings. They have Velvet parking facility too.

🧼 Cleanliness:
Overall cleanliness is decent considering the heavy crowd, though seating gets busy during peak hours.

📌 Overall:
Great place for juices, desserts, and innovative snacks with fun presentation. Perfect hangout spot for friends and family in Borivali.

Highly recommended 👍

featured_reviews.name: kajol patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bunty Cafe is a charming establishment that offers both indoor air-conditioned seating and outdoor seating, allowing guests to enjoy their meals in a setting that suits their preference. One of the standout features of this cafe is its popular range of juices, which are served in a visually appealing and creative way. The presentation adds an extra touch to the overall experience, making it more enjoyable.

A particular highlight was the Chaupati Sandwich, which was full of flavor and left a lasting impression. However, the pasta was a bit of a disappointment. Instead of the expected pasta sauce, it had a taste resembling a paneer gravy, which was not quite what one would expect from a pasta dish.

For dessert, the Strawberry Cream was quite delightful, offering a nice balance of sweetness and freshness. Additionally, the cafe offers a variety of funky juices, each presented with a unique setup that adds to the overall appeal. Although the juice setups are quite fancy, the juices themselves are priced higher than expected, but they remain fairly average in terms of taste.

The ambience of the cafe is simple and unassuming, but it provides a comfortable space for conversations and casual hangouts. It's a great spot for a relaxed chit-chat with friends or family, making it an ideal place to spend time with loved ones over a refreshing drink.

featured_reviews.name: Nishita Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am very disappointed and upset with the experience I had at your outlet. I ordered a fresh fruit juice expecting proper hygiene, quality, and basic customer respect, but what I received was completely unacceptable.

Firstly, the juice served to me was clearly water-based and diluted instead of being a genuine fresh fruit juice as advertised on your menu. Charging customers for “fresh juice” and then serving mixed, low-quality diluted juice is highly misleading and unethical. Customers pay for quality and transparency, not for adulterated drinks.

Secondly, the hygiene standards were extremely poor. The overall condition and the way the juice was served raised serious concerns about cleanliness and food safety. Such unhygienic practices can directly affect customers’ health.

What shocked me the most was the behaviour of your staff. Instead of addressing the concern professionally, they used rude and disrespectful words and showed absolutely no sense of how to treat customers. This kind of behaviour is unacceptable in any service industry. A customer raising a genuine concern should never be treated disrespectfully.

I strongly condemn:

* Serving diluted/water-mixed juice while claiming it is fresh fruit juice
* Poor hygiene standards
* Misleading customers
* Extremely rude and unprofessional staff behaviour
* Lack of accountability and customer service

This has been one of the worst experiences I have had, and I will never recommend anyone to visit your outlet. I am also considering filing an official consumer complaint against your outlet for misleading food practices and poor customer treatment.

I expect immediate attention to this matter and a proper explanation regarding:

1. Why diluted juice was served under the name of fresh fruit juice
2. Why hygiene standards are being ignored
3. Why staff members are allowed to misbehave with customers

Kindly take this complaint seriously before more customers face similar issues.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Jungle Juice at Mahaveer Nagar, Kandivali is truly a fantastic place for anyone who loves fresh and healthy beverages. The quality of juices, smoothies, shakes, and other drinks is excellent, and you can genuinely taste the freshness in every sip. The ingredients feel premium, the flavors are rich and natural, and the presentation is always appealing. I was especially impressed by how well they maintain hygiene and cleanliness, which adds a lot to the overall experience.

The staff is polite, friendly, and provides quick service, making every visit pleasant. Whether you want a refreshing fruit juice, a nutritious smoothie, or a delicious thick shake, this place has a great variety to choose from. The taste is consistently good, and the quality remains the same every time, which is something I really appreciate.

The ambiance is also nice and welcoming, making it a perfect spot to stop by for a healthy refreshment. In an area like Mahaveer Nagar, Jungle Juice stands out as a reliable and enjoyable destination for quality drinks. Highly recommended for anyone looking for freshness, taste, and great service all in one place. Will definitely visit again!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Monopoly, a veg restaurant in Borivali West, Mumbai, and I had a great experience! The restaurant has a cozy and welcoming ambiance, making it a perfect spot for a relaxing evening out with friends or family.

I tried their pasta, and it was absolutely delicious! The flavors were rich, and the presentation was top-notch. The service was also excellent, with friendly and attentive staff who were more than happy to accommodate my requests.

The restaurant serves a variety of cuisines, and I'm sure they have something for everyone. The prices are reasonable, making it a great value for money.

Overall, I had a fantastic time at Monopoly, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great dining experience. The food, service, and ambiance all came together to create a truly enjoyable experience.

*Rating:* 5/5 stars

*Price Range:* Moderate (₹200-₹500 per person)

*Recommended For:* Couples, friends, and anyone seeking a relaxing evening out.

*Will I Return?:* Absolutely! I'm already planning my next visit.

If you're looking for a great place to dine in Mumbai, I highly recommend giving Monopoly a try. You won't be disappointed!

featured_reviews.name: Anshita Saxena
featured_reviews.review_text:
Best late night spot in Mumbai😱😻

Visited Monopoly in Borivali (just opposite Kalyan Jewellers) and absolutely loved the experience! It’s a pure vegetarian and Jain-friendly restaurant, which is a big plus 👍
The board-games themed ambience makes this place super fun — you can enjoy great food along with board games, perfect for friends, family, and even kids 🎲😄

Must-try dishes:
🧀 Melting Cheese Corn Balls – super cheesy and delicious
🥘 Pav Bhaji Fondue – heaven for every Mumbaikar
🍔 Popeye Green Burger & Carbon Black Burger – fun and tasty
🥗 Desi Nachos Bhel – unique and flavorful
🔥 Pahadi Jungli Cheese Blast Grill – full of bold flavours
🍝 Chinese-style Pasta – creamy and well balanced
🍜 Hot-Pot Korean Maggi & Spicy Schezwan Maggi – perfect for spice lovers

Portions are generous, food quality is excellent, and the taste is totally satisfying 😋

Another big highlight — they are open till 3:30 AM every day, making it a perfect late-night food spot 🌙✨
Overall, a great place for good food, fun vibes, and late-night cravings. Highly recommended! 💯🙌

featured_reviews.review_text: Worst place! Unhygienic. Too high rates compare to quality. Sandwich is pathetic. Don't waste money here.  Mangesh wadapav at Babhai is better. 👍🏻

featured_reviews.name: Pradosh Nair
featured_reviews.review_text: This was my favorite joint when in college (1990s) loved to have their sugarcane juice and chat shared with friends. Sadly today I can’t do that the space is split. Still do go to the place and enjoy a snack for nostalgia sake.

featured_reviews.name: Ishika P
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had cheese pav bhaji alongwith tawa pulao both were amazing , also vadapavs are the best .
Fast service and there are many other options to try out as in their shakes , sandwiches ,chats etc .
Everything good item is affordable and the vibe is also good. They are open till 10:30 on Sundays.

experience_details.name: Vegetarian offerings
experience_details.value: Menu is all vegetarian, Large vegetarian selection

featured_reviews.name: Amit Mahadik
featured_reviews.review_text: Rates are reasonable. Owner should think of bigger place.. U must try Rawa masala dosa and pav bhaaji, very tasty. Only the problem is one needs to take care of their vehicle parkings (2/4 wheeler).. If owner can think of this also it will be great..

featured_reviews.name: Shivam Kumbhar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Popular for good grilled sandwiches and Vada Pav.
Service was late even when there was just moderate crowd.

featured_reviews.name: C
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ordered the Special pizza.

It had only mushrooms and dry fruits, along with cheese.

Onion, tomatoes and other veggies weren't there at all. Wasn't given the pizza herbs and spices too that other restaurants usually provide.

Not satisfied.

featured_reviews.name: Rasika More
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice place to have quick snacks and also for dining. Cozy ambeince but the food quality n quantity is awesome with affordable prices.
